[[File:Bot roster.png|thumb|220x220px|Class wheel/roster showcasing some Bots, as seen on the loading screen in v4.0.]]
The term ''''Bot'''<nowiki/>' refers to any Transformers character, be they Autobot, Decepticon, Maximal or Predacon. There are six classes of bots: [[Brawler]], [[Warrior]], [[Scout]], [[Tech]], and [[Demolitions]], and [[Tactician]].



Each class has a Class advantage over each other, so it is smart to plan out your squad. Bots can also interact with each other by [[Synergy Bonus]]es. There are three ''Transformers'' universes from which these characters come from: '''Generations''' (with designs based on toys from various toylines) '''Cinematic''' (live-action film series), and '''''Beast Wars''.'''

Bots vary in star rarity, from 1-Star to 5-Star. Each Bot has a Rating that can be increased by leveling and ranking up the Bot.  Each Bot has three unique Special Attacks, as well as a [[Signature Ability]] that is awakened from getting a duplicate.

== Class Bonus ==
[[File:Kabam_class_bonus_chart.png|center|thumb|300x300px|''Each class has one advantage over another class, and one disadvantage against another class'']]
[[File:Kabam reticle.png|thumb|''You can view the enemy class breakdown within a mission by selecting the reticle icon on the bottom-right corner of the screen above the quit mission icon.''|none]]
[[File:Kabam enemy class breakdown.png|thumb|''On the pop up that appears, you can view how many enemies of each class type are in the mission, as well as determine the enemy class type of the boss by the skull icon.''|none]]

==Squad==
''Using the correct strategy to create an effective team will help you optimize your performance in battle. There are several tools that will help you choose the right bots for the task ahead. To edit your squad before you begin a mission, tap on the EDIT SQUAD button.''

''Tap on the bots on your squad to remove them from the team, and tap on available bots to add them to it.''
 
''Preview the bots in the mission and filter your available bots to find the most suitable options for your improved squad by tapping on the buttons of the upper-right corner of the screen.''

== Ablilities ==
''Abilities are bonuses that augment how bots fight and protect themselves. Each bot has its own set of abilities, including a signature ability. To view a bot’s abilities, tap the BOTS tab, choose the specific bot, and tap on the INFO button.''


''Screenshot showing an example of a bot’s signature ability''


''Abilities can be permanent or temporary bonuses. Permanent bonuses are passive or activated on Critical Hit. Temporary bonuses have a chance to activate when you use your special attacks. All abilities are typically themed around the background story of each bot.''


''A screenshot showing the explanation of a bot's abilities in depth''


''The amount and strength of abilities for each bot may change, depending on their Tier and Rank. For example, Optimus Prime at Tier 1 (1 Star), Rank 1, will only have the ability Guardian Slash available. When you rank him up to Rank 2, the ability I’ll Take You All On! (special) will become available.''


''PERMANENT ABILITY BONUS''

''This bonus will always be active during a fight and may be triggered at any time, depending upon its description. These abilities are not related to special attacks.''


''SPECIAL ATTACK BONUS''

''This bonus has a chance to activate with the use of a special attack. The effect of this attack increases with the level of the bot’s special attack.''

== Bot Level, Rank, and Tier ==
''Each bot has a Tier, Rank, and Level. You can see this information by going to your BOTS tab on your home screen, then tapping on your bot, and opening the INFO panel.''

''Tiers range from 1-star to 4-stars, and cannot be changed. The higher the tier, the better the stats of your bot. Tiers control synergy bonuses and allow your bot to rank up higher.''

''Levels and Ranks can be increased.''

''Levels increase the power of a bot. Ranks increase the max level of a bot. For example, your bot can reach level 10 in rank 1, and level 20 in rank 2. The level cap is always 10 times as much as the rank.''

''When your bot reaches the maximum level for the rank, you will be required to rank up in order to unlock new levels. Ranking up will also increase the effectiveness of normal abilities like Bleed, Armor Break, etc.''

=== ''MAXIMUM RANK FOR EACH TIER:'' ===
''1 Star: Rank 2''

''2 Star: Rank 3''

''3 Star: Rank 4''

''4 Star: Rank 4''

=== ''MAXIMUM LEVELS FOR EACH RANK:'' ===
''Rank 1: 10 (1 to 4 Stars)''

''Rank 2: 20 (1 to 4 Stars)''

''Rank 3: 30 (2 to 4 Stars)''

''Rank 4: 40 (3 to 4 Stars)''

''Remember that you will need to rank up 2-Star and 3-Star Bots to unlock their tier 2 and tier 3 specials (respectively).'' '''This system was dropped in v.2.0 or v3.0.'''

''1-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack''

''2-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack''

''3-Star Bot: Starts with a two-bar special attack''

''4-Star Bot: Starts with a three-bar special attack''{{Bots}}
